88:t_029:13.en:
$n
「The $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$... $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$... A new $$スフィア・リアクター$$...」

88:t_030:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What's wrong, $$ランド・トラビス$$? Is that all the anger you've got?」

88:t_030:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Heh... Your own awakening seems to be progressing, but the $$傷だらけの獅子$$ isn't responding... Is there some reason?」

88:t_030:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Shut up! You're my enemy! You've got no right to talk about me and $$ガンレオン$$!」

88:t_030:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Well, that's fine. Your $$スフィア$$ will join $$サイデリアル$$ someday, too. Struggle all you like until then.」

88:t_100:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
(I-I must hurry...! I can't make a fool of myself in front of him!)

88:t_100:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
(If I fail again, my life will be in danger...!)

88:t_101:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I don't like you. You look as if you think you represent all light.」

88:t_101:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「You...! What are you talking about!?」

88:t_101:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'm not asking you to understand. Just get out of my sight.」

88:t_102:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You're flitting around like a pest... I'll tear off those wings you're so proud of.」

88:t_102:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「What's with this guy...!? Is he fighting on emotion alone?」

88:t_102:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What's wrong with that? I just fight as my heart tells me to.」

88:t_103:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You're piloting an interesting machine. You look worth killing.」

88:t_103:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「He's neither a soldier nor a warrior...! He's just a child throwing his power around on a whim!」

88:t_103:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's right. I'm just letting out the feelings swirling inside me.」

88:t_104:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you think I'll go easy on you because you're a child, you're dead wrong.」

88:t_104:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't underestimate the great $$竹尾ワッ太$$! I've fought to protect Earth, too!」

88:t_104:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Protect it? Fighting for others is absurd.」

88:t_105:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I wonder how you'll cry if I smash that toy right in front of you.」

88:t_105:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I won't let you! $$鉄人$$ will never lose!」

88:t_105:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Hearing that makes me want to break it even more. Your toy, and your heart.」

88:t_106:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「So you're the poison $$ティファ$$ warned us about!」

88:t_106:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'll take on anyone who scares $$ティファ$$! Get ready!」

88:t_106:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I don't like you... I especially don't like you...」

88:t_106:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Anyone who fights for someone else should die... No, I'll kill them myself.」

88:t_107:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Demon scorpion or pork cutlet, I don't care! You're the enemy boss!」

88:t_107:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I've no interest in dealing with a stupid brat. I'll get rid of you quickly.」

88:t_107:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「You bastard! Don't think the great $$勝平$$ will go down that easily!」

88:t_107:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「It's rather nice to kill someone who thinks they're the one person who won't die...」

88:t_108:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. The enemy unit appears to be a special type even among $$サイデリアル$$ forces. Careless contact is dangerous.」

88:t_108:1.en:
$$レド$$
「But leaving him alone is even more dangerous! We're moving forward, $$チェインバー#pilot$$!」

88:t_108:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「A $$マシンキャリバー$$, built for group combat, operating alone... You're a stray dog separated from its pack.」

88:t_108:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Let me put you down quickly.」

88:t_109:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Is it an enemy after all...? If so, then...)

88:t_110:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'm disappointed. To think the $$いがみ合う双子$$' $$リアクター$$ is this weak.」

88:t_110:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Even $$ガドライト#pilot$$ was better. Maybe I should kill you and bet on someone else awakening the $$スフィア$$.」

88:t_110:3.en:
$n
「I don't care about the $$スフィア$$ itself...」

88:t_110:4.en:
$n
「But $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ risked his life to give it to me! I won't forgive anyone who mocks it!」

88:t_110:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Come to think of it... I heard he died. Serves him right.」

88:t_110:6.en:
$n
「You...! Do you want to make me angry that badly!?」

88:t_110:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You're small-minded. If words like these shake your emotions, you'll never overcome the hatred inside me.」

88:t_111:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Scorpion poison and butterfly poison... I think we'll get along.」

88:t_111:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Don't compare the $$ホワイトドール$$ to something that spreads destruction like you!」

88:t_111:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Do you really mean that? Wasn't it the $$ターンタイプ$$ that spread destruction?」

88:t_111:3.en:
$$ロラン$$
「You know about the $$黒歴史$$...!?」

88:t_111:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「The Moon Queen fulfilled her mission. The butterfly's poison was the result.」

88:t_111:5.en:
$$ロラン$$
「That's nonsense...! I won't be misled by your words!!」

88:t_112:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
(Miss $$ソシエ$$, Miss $$キエル$$... I'll come back. I promise.)

88:t_112:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
(And Lady $$ディアナ$$... I'll use the $$ホワイトドール$$'s power you entrusted to me for everyone's sake...!)

88:t_113:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「It's been a while, $$ランド・トラビス$$. And $$メール・ビーター$$.」

88:t_113:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「I've been looking for you. I never thought you'd crossed over to the $$アメリア$$ Continent.」

88:t_113:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I wasn't running from you. I have missions of my own.」

88:t_113:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'm not listening to your bullshit...! You'll pay for what you've done!」

88:t_113:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you mean $$クラヴィア$$, it wasn't my fault. That was her true self.」

88:t_113:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「Shut up! Everyone has something inside they can't show other people!」

88:t_113:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「And I'll beat the shit out of the filthy bastard who forced it out of her!!」

88:t_114:0.en:
$$メール$$
「We're lucky, suddenly barging into the big showdown like this!」

88:t_114:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hell yeah! We'll meet old friends, free $$アメリア$$, and beat up $$バルビエル$$ to boot!」

88:t_114:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「We'll do it all at once! Full power, $$ガンレオン・マグナ$$!!」
